regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing rotation (eligible breadth 23/49, absorption 0.32, no one-narrative dominance) with energy themes rising behind a still-top-ranked but trend-gate-ineligible Memory/HBM theme. The absolute-trend gate is the only validated risk-control edge here (gate_helps=true), and my own track record on direction is weak (0.418), so I will keep convictions low and lean only where the durability/breadth legs are actually confirming.
emerging_watch: Watching Energy (Equal-Weight) for a confirmed leadership handoff: if XLE's equal-weight sleeve breadth rises above 0.70 while US Energy Complex remains eligible and Memory/HBM stays trend-gate-ineligible, I would retire the 'narrow challenger' watch and treat energy leadership as confirmed.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy Complex is the highest-ranked eligible theme with the absolute-trend gate open, durability_bar at a healthy 0.6, and breadth 0.682 — the only eligible name in the top three. That combination supports a continuing (not predicted) trend-continuation lean under the validated drawdown-control discipline.
evidence: eligible=true and trend-gate open (the one validated edge)
durability_bar 0.6 (above the 0.5 mid-line, coincident staying-power read)
breadth 0.682 (broad participation vs. many sub-0.4 tech names)
rank 2 but rank-IC is ~0, so rank is treated as focus, not a buy signal
theses.dissent: The rotation is narrowing and energy is the challenger, not the leader — any macro re-pricing that favors defensives (healthcare/staples, which are crowded and trend-firm) could quickly rotate out of a mid-range breadth energy complex.

theses.subject: Big Pharma

theses.dissent: Crowding_z of 1.56 is the highest in the entire eligible set — reflexivity risk means a sharp sentiment unwind could hit pharma hard before any trend signal exits.

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Equal-weight healthcare carries the strongest breadth in the entire eligible set (0.817) with a high durability_bar (0.77) and a 'trend' hurst tag — the broadest, most internally-confirmed trend among eligible themes, in line with the validated drawdown-avoidance discipline.
evidence: crowding_z 1.43 → crowded=true, treated as a position-size caution only per guardrails
theses.dissent: Crowding is extreme (z 1.43) and the theme is categorically defensive — if the unscheduled geopolitical surprise dominating the macro backdrop resolves bullishly, a risk-on rotation could leave health care lagging sharply.
